text: The authors propose testing persona-aware debate and consultancy with human judges, as they did with persona-conditioned LLM judges, extending beyond binary verifiable claims to manipulated content, satire and propaganda, and running longitudinal studies on initially unresolved prediction-market claims to separate mainstream bias from truth-seeking.
title: Persona-aware debate with human judges; unresolved claims to separate bias from truth
